title: The Flyagonal Options Strategy: 96% Win Rate and $24k in 2 Months
summary: Steve Gunn (sjgtrades.com) pitches the 'flyagonal' — a delta-neutral SPX combo of a put diagonal below (long vol) plus a call broken-wing butterfly above (short vol), 8-10 DTE, taking ~10% of max loss; mechanically the same structure as Simon Black's Time Flies, independently developed. Headline '96% win rate / $24k in 2 months' rests on just 58/60 winning trades over ~10 weeks of a benign low-vol regime, with admittedly unfinalized mechanics and heavy course/alert sales motive. Write-up: strategies/flyagonal.md (conviction 1.5/5).
